record.question: Recently, which sportsman has been awarded the USA's Presidential Medal of Freedom ?
record.explanation: Answer A: Tiger woods. The archived White House list and 2019 award remarks identify Tiger Woods as a recipient of the Presidential Medal of Freedom on 6 May 2019. Reference: https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/medaloffreedom/; https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/briefings-statements/remarks-president-trump-presentation-presidential-medal-freedom-eldrick-tiger-woods/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
